description: Find a foreground color that meets one or more WCAG 2.1 contrast targets against a background. Binary-searches OKLCH lightness (holding hue/chroma fixed) and returns the nearest-compliant hex plus the achieved ratio. Pass `target` for one target or `targets` for several; `prefer` selects lighter/darker/either; `hue`/`chroma` pin the foreground chromaticity. If BOTH `target` and `targets` are provided, `targets` takes precedence. The response shape differs by mode: a single `target` returns `{ met, color, ratio }` (with an optional `nearMiss` flag); `targets` returns `{ results: [{ met, color, ratio, nearMiss? }, ...] }`. The output schema is an all-optional superset of both shapes (SDK 1.29 single-shape limitation). An unparseable background returns the PARSE_FAILED error; a translucent background (alpha < 1, e.g. rgba()/hsla()/#rgba/#rrggbbaa) returns ALPHA_UNSUPPORTED — composite it over its backdrop first.

background.description: Background CSS color string, e.g. "#FFFFFF", "oklch(0.6 0.1 240)" (max 256 chars).

chroma.description: Fixed OKLCH chroma (>= 0) held constant during the lightness search (reduced along the fixed hue when the sRGB gamut requires it). Defaults to the background's own chroma when omitted; pass chroma explicitly to keep saturation when fixing hue. Giving chroma WITHOUT hue fixes the hue to the background's hue, or to 0 when the background is achromatic.

hue.description: Fixed OKLCH hue (degrees, cyclic) held constant during the lightness search. Giving hue WITHOUT chroma does not add saturation: chroma then defaults to the background's own chroma, which is 0 for achromatic backgrounds (white/grey/black), so the result is an achromatic gray and the hue has no visible effect — pass chroma explicitly to keep saturation when fixing hue.

prefer.description: Search direction relative to the background lightness. Default "either".

target.description: Single WCAG 2.1 contrast target (e.g. 4.5, 7). Use this OR `targets` (targets wins if both given).

targets.description: Multiple WCAG 2.1 contrast targets (1-50 entries; an empty array is rejected). Takes precedence over `target`. Returns one result per target.

name: solve_for_contrast

color.description: SINGLE-target: nearest-compliant foreground hex, or null when unreachable

met.description: SINGLE-target: whether the target contrast was achievable

nearMiss.description: SINGLE-target: present/true when met was granted via the near-ceiling tolerance

ratio.description: SINGLE-target: achieved WCAG 2.1 ratio (display-rounded), or peak attainable when not met

results.description: MULTI-target: one result per requested target (present only for the `targets` path)

color.description: Nearest-compliant foreground hex, or null when no candidate in the searched band was measurable

met.description: Whether the target contrast was achievable

nearMiss.description: Present/true when met was granted via the near-ceiling tolerance (raw ratio within MET_TOL below target)

ratio.description: Achieved WCAG 2.1 ratio (display-rounded), or peak attainable when met is false; null only when no candidate was measurable (an unparseable background returns the PARSE_FAILED tool error instead)
